propositions: Three defensive exception handlers in gate_dispatch and container_stage that route LLM-tier failures to ABORT or DEGRADE have zero test coverage reaching them, verified by mutation testing.

The plan-review mid-run arm in gate_dispatch (produce_plan_review_verdict and _run_code_review_gate) is reachable in production via batch-step paths but lacks test coverage for both LLMUnavailableError and LLMInputRejectedError exception types.
The container_stage warm-call abort in _run_container is reachable but untested; it must abort (raise immediately) rather than degrade for both LLMUnavailableError and LLMInputRejectedError.

The code-review mid-run arm in gate_dispatch is a defensive seam contract (batch-runner raises are never in-tree for code-review path); it requires test coverage as contract pinning rather than removal.
